claim.statement: OpenAI's 0.90.0 release notes say the release added ephemeral threads and improved collaboration-tool provenance metadata for spawned threads.

source.title: OpenAI Codex release 0.90.0
source.locator: New Features — ephemeral threads and spawned-thread provenance metadata (#9765, #9769)

limitations: The release note is a publisher description and does not define the full ephemeral-thread lifecycle.
No thread was created, observed, resumed, persisted or deleted by the catalog.
unknowns: The provenance fields, propagation rules and completeness of spawned-thread attribution are unknown.
The lifetime, persistence, cleanup, context inheritance, tool authority and resource limits of ephemeral threads are unknown.
